title: 2027 Graduate Industrial Designer
note: Graduate-level role at PA's Irish design studio near Dublin; a bachelor's in industrial design (or one underway) is required.

facts.summary: Graduate industrial designer role at PA Consulting's design and innovation studio in Bray, Ireland, working on consumer, professional and healthcare products.
facts.duties: Do user research, develop product concepts and user experiences, sketch and model by hand and in CAD, and present work to clients.
facts.requirements: ID bachelor's (completed or underway), strong portfolio, hand sketching and craft modelling, Rhino/SolidWorks/KeyShot, Adobe/Figma, basic engineering and manufacturing knowledge.
facts.apply: Apply online with portfolio; portfolio review, virtual interview, then in-person interview in Bray.
